name: waldos-world-youtube-monitor
description: Daily monitor for the YouTube channel @WaldosWorld. Fetches the latest videos, compares against the newest previously seen video persisted between runs, and creates a Gmail draft when a newer video is found. Scheduled daily at 09:00 Europe/Helsinki.

steps.name: Fetch latest videos
steps.parse: rss entries -> [{videoId, title, published, link}] sorted by published desc

steps.name: Compare against persisted state
steps.logic: new videos = entries with published > state.lastPublished and videoId not in state.seen

steps.name: Create Gmail draft if newer video found
steps.subject: New video on Waldo's World
steps.body: For each new video: title, published date, link (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<videoId>)
